data.desc:
RentNivas is an online rental property platform built for India. Find verified flats, rooms, and houses for rent across cities — with smart filters, gamified rewards, and a seamless booking experience.

Whether you are a tenant looking for your next home or a landlord listing your property, RentNivas makes it simple, fast, and trustworthy.
data.feat:
Verified rental listings across India.
Smart city and locality filters.
Gamified rewards for users.
Easy property listing for landlords.
Mobile-friendly experience.
